coordinateNote: Bounds are Blender world space after GLB import (Z up = board vertical, X = left/right, front surface faces -Y). Body front plane is y=-0.052997 on body-board.

mappings.evidence: Full-width mesh spanning x -0.285..0.285 at the top of the board (z 0.023..0.060); matches app contact 'Full-width top jug'. Confirmed in selection-review/top-jug.png and the top blue band of all-holds-review.png.

Central granite mesh, ~104 mm wide (x -0.052..0.052), seated in the lower board band (z -0.042..-0.027); front face y=-0.0526 is essentially flush with the body front (y=-0.052997), the shallowest center feature. Matches app contact 'Center 22 mm edge'. Confirmed in selection-review/centre-granite-edge.png and all-holds-review.png.

Inner-left tapered wooden mesh (x -0.18..-0.078), z-span 0.023 m (-0.051..-0.028) larger than the neighbouring granite edge, consistent with a tapering depth gradient. Matches app contact 'Left gradient 10-25 mm edge'. Confirmed in selection-review/left-tapered-wood-edge.png.
Mirror of left-tapered-wood-edge about x=0 (center +0.129 vs -0.129). Matches app contact 'Right gradient 10-25 mm edge'. Confirmed in selection-review/right-tapered-wood-edge.png.

Outer-left granite mesh (x -0.264..-0.18) in the lower board band, contiguous with the inner tapered wood edge; matches the app composite contact on the left lower wing. Confirmed in selection-review/left-granite-edge.png.
Mirror of left-granite-edge about x=0 (center +0.222 vs -0.222). Matches the app composite contact on the right lower wing. Confirmed in selection-review/right-granite-edge.png.

Central recessed wooden mesh (x -0.05..0.05) set above the centre granite edge (z 0.015..0.03 vs z -0.042..-0.027); the only remaining center feature, matched to the remaining center app contact 'Center continuous 30 mm granite / ergonomic wood contact'. Confirmed in selection-review/upper-centre-wood-edge.png.
